scientific_question: Can an open response query retrieve an independent COVID severity design from a source-disjoint candidate collection, and does unresolved MS2 add correct coverage beyond measurement-matched known-only evidence?

source_axes.qualification: the 18-file extension is append-only and must be combined with the already frozen 83 non-critical files through a joint phenotype-blind measurement stage

source_axes.contrast: severe, critical illness or death minus mild or asymptomatic COVID-19

fixed_controls: unresolved MS2 reassigned within measurement strata
response labels reassigned while preserving source composition
gates_before_activation: one-to-one biological-unit topology in each source
phenotype-blind measurement construction and hashed MS2 links
age and sex adjustment or explicit residual-confounding boundary when metadata permit
frozen library search before known versus unresolved comparison
open candidate retrieval with incorrect and abstain outcomes, not a two-candidate forced choice
claim_boundary: This is a pre-effect development contract, not a positive retrieval result.
Plasma and serum are related but non-identical matrices; their relation is design relevance, not exact replication.
Disease severity labels are observational and may include treatment, age, sex, collection-date and hospitalization confounding.
No shared disease label or chemical similarity is sufficient to merge beta and SE across different entities.
Failure of this pair falsifies this registered relation or implementation; it does not redefine the Metabolomic Contrast Atlas objective.
